---
title: "The decisions"
description: "One record per architectural decision of the kernel: what was decided, why, and what it costs."
---

<!-- Generated by bun run docs:generate (scripts/sync-guides.ts) from docs/adr/: edit the records. -->

Each record says what was decided, the context it was decided in, and what
follows from it. A later decision that changes an earlier one names the
record it amends or supersedes. The guide,
[the kernel](/docs/guide/), says how the parts fit as they are today.

| ADR | Decision | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [0001](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-kernel-plugin-composition.md) | How the kernel's plugins compose | accepted |
| [0002](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-core-owns-state-plugins-own-workflows.md) | Core owns state and events, plugins own every workflow | accepted |
| [0003](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-journal-holds-the-conversation.md) | The journal holds the conversation; records carry tags; memory builds the context; the kernel has no loop | accepted |
| [0004](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0004-tool-traffic-is-conversation.md) | Tool traffic is conversation; tools are code; failures are data; memory keeps calls paired | accepted |
| [0005](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0005-context-for-one-request.md) | Context for one request is added after memory's, never stored | accepted |
| [0006](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0006-a-sub-agent-is-a-session.md) | A sub-agent is a session with a parent | accepted |
| [0007](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0007-a-tool-reaches-its-turn.md) | A tool reaches the turn its call runs in through `CurrentTurn` | accepted |
| [0008](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-a-memory-keeps-its-summary.md) | A memory keeps what it derived as a record of its own, and asks the host for a model's work | accepted |
| [0009](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0009-what-the-ui-shows-is-a-record.md) | What the UI shows is a record tagged ui; a client folds them; the model never sees them | accepted |
| [0010](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0010-a-store-is-a-part.md) | A store is a part; a turn left open is closed by the host that knows its writer is gone | accepted |
| [0011](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0011-a-long-result-is-sent-as-a-pointer.md) | A long result is sent as a pointer, by a rule that reads only the record | accepted |
| [0012](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0012-a-tool-asks-through-a-contract.md) | A tool asks through a contract the host provides; the answer is a record | accepted |
| [0013](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0013-a-skill-is-loaded-by-a-tool-call.md) | A skill is loaded by a tool call; what is offered is a fold of the journal | accepted |
| [0014](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0014-what-an-agent-knows-is-a-journal-of-its-own.md) | What an agent knows across conversations is a journal of its own | accepted |
| [0015](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0015-a-model-call-is-planned-and-an-answer-is-made-once.md) | A model call is planned, and an answer is made once | accepted |
| [0016](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0016-a-branch-is-a-copy-cut-at-a-closed-turn.md) | A branch is a copy, cut at a closed turn | accepted |
| [0017](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0017-a-workspace-is-the-world-the-agent-acts-on.md) | A workspace is the world an agent acts on, not a store of the agent | accepted |
| [0018](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0018-a-background-task-reports-in-a-turn-of-its-own.md) | A background task reports in a turn of its own | accepted |
| [0019](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0019-what-an-agent-knows-can-be-connected.md) | What an agent knows can be connected | superseded by ADR 0022 |
| [0020](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0020-a-model-call-s-cost-is-held-before-it-is-sent.md) | A model call's cost is held before it is sent | accepted |
| [0021](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0021-what-is-recalled-by-meaning-is-an-index-of-the-journal.md) | What is recalled by meaning is an index of the journal | accepted |
| [0022](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0022-memory-is-kept-by-a-curator.md) | Memory is kept by a curator, after the turn | accepted |
| [0023](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0023-what-is-recalled-is-chosen-from-the-conversation.md) | What is recalled is chosen from the conversation | accepted |
| [0024](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0024-the-kernel-s-node-ports-live-on-an-entry-of-their-own.md) | The kernel's Node ports live on an entry of their own; a durable store has one writer, and the host recovers what the last one left open | accepted |
| [0025](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0025-what-is-recalled-can-also-be-found-by-meaning.md) | What is recalled can also be found by meaning | accepted |
| [0026](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0026-a-model-provider-charges-the-ledger-it-is-given.md) | A model provider charges the ledger it is given | accepted |
| [0028](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0028-the-workspace-s-ports-are-the-app-s-to-plug-in.md) | The workspace's ports are the app's to plug in: files on a disk, a shell, a search | accepted |
| [0030](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0030-a-kernel-host-s-telemetry-is-effect-s-exported-around-its-program.md) | A kernel host's telemetry is Effect's, exported around its program | accepted |
| [0032](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0032-a-remote-embedder-charges-the-ledger-as-a-model-does.md) | A remote embedder charges the ledger as a model does | accepted |
| [0034](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0034-media-is-kept-by-its-hash.md) | Media is kept by its hash | accepted |
| [0036](https://github.com/xandreeddev/efferent/blob/main/docs/adr/0036-the-old-engine-goes-and-the-kernel-takes-the-package-roots.md) | The old engine goes, and the kernel takes the package roots | accepted |
